{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}
module Codec.Serialization.Store where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeFileName, isRelative)
import System.Directory (createDirectoryIfMissing, doesFileExist)
import Data.Word (Word8, Word32)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, (.|.))
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

-- Feature flags for the serialization codec
data CodecFeatures = CodecFeatures
  { enableCompression :: Bool
  , enableEncryption  :: Bool
  , enableExternalRefs :: Bool
  , enableUnicodeNorm :: Bool
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

defaultFeatures :: CodecFeatures
defaultFeatures = CodecFeatures True False False False

-- Archive entry metadata
data ArchiveEntry = ArchiveEntry
  { entryName     :: T.Text
  , entrySize     :: Word32
  , entryChecksum :: Word32
  , entryPayload  :: BS.ByteString
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

-- The store context
data StoreContext = StoreContext
  { storeBasePath :: FilePath
  , storeFeatures :: CodecFeatures
  } deriving (Show)

-- Parse a 4-byte little-endian word
parseWord32 :: BS.ByteString -> Word32
parseWord32 bs
  | BS.length bs >= 4 =
      let b0 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 0) :: Word32
          b1 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 1) :: Word32
          b2 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 2) :: Word32
          b3 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 3) :: Word32
      in b0 .|. (b1 `shiftL` 8) .|. (b2 `shiftL` 16) .|. (b3 `shiftL` 24)
  | otherwise = 0

-- Normalize path separators for cross-platform compatibility
normalizeSeparators :: T.Text -> T.Text
normalizeSeparators = T.replace "\\" "/"

-- Core path validation logic
-- When unicode normalization is enabled, we apply NFC normalization
-- which can transform certain sequences
validateEntryPath :: CodecFeatures -> T.Text -> Either String FilePath
validateEntryPath features rawPath =
  let -- Step 1: normalize separators
      separated = normalizeSeparators rawPath
      -- Step 2: optionally apply unicode normalization
      normalized = if enableUnicodeNorm features
                   then T.pack (unicodeNormNFC (T.unpack separated))
                   else separated
      -- Step 3: check for traversal patterns
      pathStr = T.unpack normalized
      segments = filter (not . null) $ splitPath pathStr
      hasTraversal = any (== "..") segments
      isAbs = not (isRelative pathStr)
  in if hasTraversal || isAbs
     then Left $ "Invalid path: traversal or absolute path detected: " ++ pathStr
     else Right pathStr

-- Split on '/'
splitPath :: String -> [String]
splitPath [] = []
splitPath s = case break (== '/') s of
  (seg, [])    -> [seg]
  (seg, _:rest) -> seg : splitPath rest

-- Simplified NFC normalization simulation
-- In real code this would use ICU or unicode-transforms
-- Key behavior: certain combining sequences get recomposed
unicodeNormNFC :: String -> String
unicodeNormNFC [] = []
unicodeNormNFC (c:cs)
  | c == '\x2025' = '.' : '.' : unicodeNormNFC cs  -- TWO DOT LEADER -> two dots
  | c == '\x2024' = '.' : unicodeNormNFC cs         -- ONE DOT LEADER -> dot
  | c == '\xFF0F' = '/' : unicodeNormNFC cs          -- FULLWIDTH SOLIDUS -> slash
  | c == '\xFF3C' = '/' : unicodeNormNFC cs          -- FULLWIDTH REVERSE SOLIDUS
  | otherwise     = c : unicodeNormNFC cs

-- Deserialize and extract archive entries to disk
deserializeArchive :: StoreContext -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String [FilePath])
deserializeArchive ctx input = do
  let features = storeFeatures ctx
      base = storeBasePath ctx
  createDirectoryIfMissing True base
  case parseEntries features input of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right entries -> do
      results <- mapM (writeEntry ctx) entries
      return (Right results)

-- Parse binary entries from the archive format
-- Format: [nameLen:4][name:nameLen][size:4][checksum:4][payload:size]
parseEntries :: CodecFeatures -> BS.ByteString -> Either String [ArchiveEntry]
parseEntries features bs = go bs []
  where
    go remaining acc
      | BS.length remaining < 4 = Right (reverse acc)
      | otherwise =
          let nameLen = fromIntegral (parseWord32 remaining) :: Int
              afterNameLen = BS.drop 4 remaining
          in if BS.length afterNameLen < nameLen + 8
             then Left "Truncated entry"
             else let nameBytes = BS.take nameLen afterNameLen
                      afterName = BS.drop nameLen afterNameLen
                      size = parseWord32 afterName
                      checksum = parseWord32 (BS.drop 4 afterName)
                      afterMeta = BS.drop 8 afterName
                      payload = BS.take (fromIntegral size) afterMeta
                      rest = BS.drop (fromIntegral size) afterMeta
                      name = TE.decodeUtf8 nameBytes
                      entry = ArchiveEntry name size checksum payload
                  in go rest (entry : acc)

-- Write a single entry, applying path validation
writeEntry :: StoreContext -> ArchiveEntry -> IO FilePath
writeEntry ctx entry = do
  let features = storeFeatures ctx
      base = storeBasePath ctx
  case validateEntryPath features (entryName entry) of
    Left err -> error err
    Right validPath -> do
      let fullPath = base </> validPath
          dir = takeDirectory fullPath
      createDirectoryIfMissing True dir
      BS.writeFile fullPath (entryPayload entry)
      return fullPath

-- Re-implementation to avoid System.FilePath dependency issues
takeDirectory :: FilePath -> FilePath
takeDirectory path =
  let parts = splitPath path
  in case parts of
    [] -> "."
    [_] -> "."
    _  -> concatWithSep "/" (init parts)

concatWithSep :: String -> [String] -> String
concatWithSep _ [] = ""
concatWithSep _ [x] = x
concatWithSep sep (x:xs) = x ++ sep ++ concatWithSep sep xs

-- External reference resolution (only when feature flag enabled)
resolveExternalRef :: StoreContext -> T.Text -> IO (Maybe BS.ByteString)
resolveExternalRef ctx refPath
  | enableExternalRefs (storeFeatures ctx) = do
      let resolved = T.unpack refPath
      exists <- doesFileExist resolved
      if exists
        then Just <$> BS.readFile resolved
        else return Nothing
  | otherwise = return Nothing
